title: Deterministic query probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $\alpha$ be a label set, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates. For a coordinate $i$, its deterministic query probability is the product-measure average, over inputs $x\in\Omega^n$, of the indicator that $T$ queries coordinate $i$ on input $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
the tree has an available-coordinate set
